title: Merge Sorted Iterators
tests:
assert list(merge_sorted_iterators([1,4], [2,3])) == [1,2,3,4]
assert list(merge_sorted_iterators([], [1,1], [1,2])) == [1,1,1,2]
assert list(merge_sorted_iterators()) == []
assert list(merge_sorted_iterators(iter([0,2]), iter([1,3]))) == [0,1,2,3]
print("Example checks passed.")
